items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer asks 'Teddy Smith?' and Interviewee responds 'Smith yes.' but does not provide any personal anecdote, collaboration history, or direct interaction with Teddy Smith, only confirming the name in the context of discussing other bands (Lucky Millinder's band had Tab Smith).

ctx.x: Well Harry took, it must have been that place. No, you know that's kind of hard for me to remember because Shad Collins was in the band. We went through a lot of trumpet players. Shad Collins was one, he may, not he didn't, he didn't take Shad's place. They were in there together. It might have been Todd's, Tuddy's place.
